question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (retro-catch-up, 75d late): US VP JD Vance announced 2026-06-15 that Iran and US representatives had digitally signed the Islamabad MOU the previous day (2026-06-14); Trump-Pezeshkian formally co-signed 2026-06-17 (Arms Control Association issue brief 2026-06; Al Jazeera 2026-06-22; NPR 2026-06-21). Convened Pakistan-mediated session with named US/Iranian principals culminating in signed instrument crosses the criterion before EOD 2026-06-16. DA and Analyst concur.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO: Peak weekly transit average through 2026-07-02 was ~25 vessels/day (down from pre-crisis ~88-130/day), never approaching the 50/day 7-day threshold (Statista Hormuz transit chart; Lloyd's List Intelligence; CNN Strait tracker). Single-day peak was 51-52 on 24-25 June but rolling 7-day average could not clear 50 given surrounding low-20s days. Traffic further deteriorated to ~10/day by 2026-07-23 after Iran's 2026-07-07 vessel strikes and 2026-07-12 declared closure. Analyst and DA concur.
resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO on two independent grounds: (1) First reading passed 2026-06-30 but Knesset dissolution bill only completed second-and-third readings on 2026-07-17, two days AFTER the 2026-07-15 deadline (Times of Israel 2026-07-17; JNS 2026-07-17; JPost 62-0 vote); (2) The date set was 2026-10-27, not earlier than 2026-10-27 as the criterion requires (coalition agreed Oct 27 in 2026-07-12 meeting). Per pre-declared ambiguity rule ('if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO'), hard NO — not AMBIGUOUS. Analyst and DA concur.
resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Times of Israel/Reuters/AP/JPost) citing the Knesset plenum vote record.
ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.
